summary: Virginia National Bankshares Corp filed an 8-K Item 8.01 to announce the completion of the sale of its indirect wholly owned subsidiary Fauquier Bank Services Inc.'s interest in Bearing Insurance Group LLC, a full-service insurance agency, effective May 1, 2026. The registrant expects a pre-tax gain of approximately $4.7 million in Q2 2026. No specific sale price, premium, or buyer details are disclosed, nor are board recommendations or advisors named. The transaction has closed; forward-looking statements caution on risks. No remaining contingent terms or regulatory clocks are mentioned. The key watchpoint is the eventual Q2 earnings impact of the gain.
